name: 48326 · Auburn Hills, MI
findings: ZIP 48326 (Auburn Hills) has 92 nonprofit organizations. 35 of them (38%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 26 organizations.
Social and fraternal organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (23% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 48326 (Auburn Hills) has fewer organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: Fewer organizations list membership
observations.text: Per resident, fewer organizations in ZIP 48326 (Auburn Hills) list membership in their tax returns or on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 41% of the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 63 organizations here; 30% of all organizations here have no identified type.
